original_ai_output.title_zh: 贡贝州运输公司否认巴士遇袭及乘客遭绑架报道
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 贡贝州运输服务公司（Gombe Line）否认有关其一辆巴士在Ayere与Kabba之间遭武装匪徒袭击、所有乘客被绑架的报道，称该说法不实。公司总经理Sani Sabo在周一发布的新闻声明中表示，其车队中没有任何车辆发生此类事件，并呼吁公众不要传播未经核实的信息。相关报道目前仅为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 贡贝州运输服务公司否认其巴士遇袭及乘客遭绑架的报道
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The management of Gombe State Transport Services, popularly known as Gombe Line, has dismissed reports alleging that one of its buses was attacked by armed bandits between Ayere and Kabba, with all passengers reportedly kidnapped.

key_facts.fact: 公司总经理Sani Sabo称车队中无车辆发生此类事件
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: “For the avoidance of doubt, no such incident has been reported involving any vehicle in our fleet,” Sabo said.

key_facts.fact: 公司呼吁公众不要传播未经核实的信息
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He urged the public to exercise caution when sharing information, particularly reports concerning security incidents, to prevent the spread of misinformation and unnecessary panic.

uncertainties: 巴士遇袭及乘客遭绑架的报道被公司否认，事件是否发生尚未证实
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
